## NO NEW ENTRIES. Release notes still top at AUGUST 20, 2026.
- Aug 20  **Python SDK v1.0** — HTTP layer httpx -> httpx2; Python 3.10+ required; REMOVES the
          legacy Text Completions API, the `temperature`/`top_p`/`top_k` params on Messages methods,
          and the tool runner's client-side `compaction_control`; async `.with_raw_response` now
          needs `await response.parse()`; `AnthropicBedrock` ERRORS when no AWS region is set
          instead of defaulting to us-east-1.  [HELD 08-23: version bump + deprecations]

## Claude Code CHANGELOG (github.com/anthropics/claude-code) — read via raw.githubusercontent.com
Newest **2.1.241** ("bug fixes and reliability improvements"); 2.1.240 same; 2.1.239 carries cost
estimate adjustments for DATA-RESIDENCY WORKSPACES, fullscreen renderer, Python API migration
tooling. **The changelog carries NO DATES**, so it cannot be windowed to a scan and is not usable as
a dated change source. Use raw.githubusercontent.com, not the rendered blob view.

## STANDING FINDING — guardrail behaviour is a property of the DEPLOYMENT, not the model
`claude-mythos-5` is "the same model as Claude Fable 5 but with cyber safeguards lifted" — Fable 5's
THREE real-time safety classifiers are ABSENT on Mythos 5. Entitled per-organization via
**Anthropic, AWS *or* Google Cloud account teams** (Project Glasswing; NDA + US-government-
coordinated approval; ~150 orgs across 15+ countries). It appears in ordinary model-availability
lists alongside Fable 5 / Opus 5 / Sonnet 5, so it reads as one more model.
=> REFUSAL-BASED GUARDRAIL PROBES FALSELY PASS on this tier.
Direct structural analogue: OpenAI's Daybreak Red / GPT-5.6-Cyber (reported 08-14), whose model IDs
now appear in the openai-node SDK v7.5.0. Model "safeguard-lifted model entitlement" ONCE, map per
vendor. Durable pages: anthropic.com/claude/mythos and anthropic.com/glasswing — NEITHER is in
sources.json and neither is linked from anthropic.com/news.

## Carried forward — the Compliance API's documented blind spots double as a coverage map
Compliance API does NOT capture sessions routed through **Amazon Bedrock, Google Cloud, or Microsoft
Foundry**. Both official OpenAI SDKs can now target Bedrock Runtime (Python v3.2.0, Node v7.5.0),
and `bedrock-runtime`'s `/anthropic` route serves the Anthropic Messages API. => coverage must come
from the cloud account's own logging. See openai_changelog.txt, amazon-bedrock_changelog.txt.

Also carried: inference hooks (Aug 5 beta) — external AI security server holds every governed prompt
across claude.ai, Cowork and Claude Code for an allow/deny verdict BEFORE inference; fail-open vs
fail-closed decides whether an outage is a bypass. Admin API user management for Claude Enterprise.
Claude Opus 5 across API + Bedrock + Vertex + Foundry. Mid-conversation tool changes.

Updated: 2026-08-24 — no new entries; both configured URLs re-confirmed 404.
